description.value: FSL-based preprocessing including motion realignment, nonlinear high-pass filtering, registration to structural and MNI space, and spatial smoothing.

quotes: Image preprocessing and statistical analysis were carried out using FSL package
FSL package

fMRI images were realigned to compensate for small residual head movements that were not captured by the PACE sequence [ 75 ]. Data were spatially smoothed using a 5-mm full-width-half-maximum (FWHM) Gaussian kernel. The data were filtered using a nonlinear high pass filter with a 100-second cut-off. A two-step registration procedure was used whereby EPI images were first registered to the MPRAGE structural image, and then into standard MNI space, using affine transformations [ 75 ]. Registration from MPRAGE structural image to standard space was further refined using FNIRT nonlinear registration [ 76 ,  77 ].
Data were spatially smoothed using a 5-mm full-width-half-maximum (FWHM) Gaussian kernel.
